newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker stable, bids/offers far apart.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker stable, bids/offers far apart.

text.p: Singapore bunker prices held steady but quotes were far apart as sellers were expecting levels to move higher, riding on cargo strength, traders said on Friday.
The cargo market is on a technical rebound and sellers think these prices would last until next week, they said.
Bunker 380-cst was quoted at $99-102 per tonne and 180-cst at $106-$109, traders said.
MDO and gas oil were quoted at $205 and $190 from Thursday's $188-$192 and $198-202 respectively.
